description.value:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Barricade] general feat. You can Barricade using resin and hazardous debris from your own body. Any attack that fails to hit you while you have cover from this barricade destroys it, dealing @Damage[4d8[acid]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20] originating from the barricade with a basic @Check[reflex|against:spell-class|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class or spell DC. You must spend 10 minutes collecting new debris and resin before you can make another barricade in this way.

Special You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Adhering Acid] on your barricade to make any creature that fails a Reflex save against your barricade @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} until the start of your next turn.
